node.name: hackathon-kiro
node.description: Browser-based horde survival game for neurocognitive stimulation in older adults. Built with Phaser 3, AWS serverless (CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito, CloudFront), and developed with Kiro using spec-driven development.

node.name: LiquidApp
node.description: LiquidApp is an intuitive solution designed to simplify the settlement of shared services and expenses in multifamily homes. With LiquidApp, residents can easily manage and split costs for utilities and common services, ensuring transparency and fairness for everyone involved.

node.name: SlideHarvest
node.description: SlideHarvest is a browser extension designed to detect embedded slide presentations in public iframes, capture them in high resolution, and export them as clean, well-formatted PDF files — all without manual screenshots.
